content.what_it_is: Fixed-form Fortran main program that reads grid size, spacing, channel depth, width, and side slope from bathy_param.txt (L6-L16); allocates depth and coordinate grids (L18); initializes a constant-depth channel and Cartesian coordinates (L20-L26); linearly reduces depth outside half the channel width (L28-L35); and writes each j row to depth.txt with fixed-width decimal formatting (L37-L42).
entities: allocatable REAL arrays DEPTH, X, Y @L1
REAL dep_channel, slope, width_channel, DX, DY @L3
unresolved: Input-to-allocation preconditions are unchecked: Mglob and Nglob read at L9-L10 are used as allocation extents at L18 and loop bounds at L20-L29 without positivity or allocation-status checks; malformed or nonpositive values fail or produce empty output.

The fixed format at L41 contains 9000 f12.6 descriptors while L39 may supply Mglob values. For Mglob above 9000, format reversion can split one intended grid row across output records, breaking the depth.txt row interface.
Depth is reduced linearly outside the channel at L30-L32 with no lower bound. Large |Y|, slope, or small dep_channel can make DEPTH negative, but the file neither rejects nor documents that regime.
X is allocated and filled at L18 and L23 but never consumed or written; DX read at L11 therefore has no effect on depth.txt.
All reads and opens at L7-L16 and L37 omit IOSTAT/ERR handling, so missing, short, or nonnumeric parameter input is not distinguished before dependent calculations.
